scope: Actual empty-source transport output/closure/deadline and selected TRACE/error adapter fixtures
limitations: Zero source blocks/audio; only bound empty/wait factory allowed, not microphone/live source integration.
Concurrent watcher tested during parent time.sleep; no arbitrary GIL/process/OS stall or descendant guarantee.
Forced child kill has no CHILD_RESULT/TRANSPORT_CLOSURE; terminal data is not logical completion.
TRACE uses counted original-accept stub plus actual retained _error; not real journal/timing/controller finalization.
STATIC: close sets closed before validation; second close returns without re-raising prior failure. Qualify fresh failure latch before launcher/GUI reuse.
Recorded owner RSS sum can duplicate child PID from independent registration plus child owner; not a unique process RSS peak.
Seven-directory layout only; GUI/entry/outer writes and whole-run/host quotas still pending.
